entities.summary: The International Islamic University Chittagong is a Bangladeshi private university in Chattogram, Bangladesh. It was founded in 1995 under the Private Universities Act of 1992. Islamic University Chittagong Trust (IUCT) is the founder organization of this university. It is one of the oldest private Higher Educational Institutions in Chittagong.
